candidates.description: This vector represents common Hindi characters, words, and grammatical suffixes.
This vector represents character n-grams and subword fragments involving the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha).
This feature vector represents conjunct consonants and vowel signs specific to the Devanagari script.
This vector activates for Hindi script characters and Devanagari vowel signs.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers attached to commas.
This vector represents common Hindi verbal roots and inflectional stems related to communication, understanding, and existence.
This feature vector represents common Hindi consonant conjuncts and word fragments ending in the retroflex flap 'ट' or dental/retroflex stops.
This feature vector represents conjunct consonants and common syllables in the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common Hindi word fragments, suffixes, and syllabic components.
This vector represents common prefixes and initial character tokens in the Hindi Devanagari script.
